item.title: Critical fire weather in Webster Parish
item.description: By Jerry Strahan First, for Webster Parish we have a critical fire weather. Low humidity, temperatures in the 60s, clear skies and strong gusty winds. We will continue in this fire weather until we get a good soaking rain. item.title: Accident claims life of Haynesville man
item.description: A two-vehicle crash in north Webster Parish Monday morning has claimed the life of a 20-year-old Haynesville man.
